records.translation: ``'well_set'``: :class:`spacr.channel_models.SpacrWellTransformer` á greypingum hverrar frumu, metið eftir verkunarmáta með brottnámsprófunum sínum og viðmiðum (:func:`spacr.well_set_training.run_well_set_training`).

records.context: ``'cell'``: the image data channel-adaptive CNN or ViT (``train_arch``) on single-cell extracted image regions (:func:`run_cell_architecture`). Optionally the ViT is first pre-trained without labels (``pretrain_method``: ``'mae'``, He et al. 2022, or ``'dino'``, Caron et al. 2021) for ``pretrain_epochs`` epochs; ``train_labels_per_class`` then keeps only that many labelled cells per class (few-shot). Every model is scored on the full stain panel and on each subset of ``eval_channel_subsets`` (the missing-stain evaluation), beside a majority-class control and, with ``train_set_shuffle_control``, a model trained on shuffled labels.
records.label: spacr.architecture_training#3
records.source: ``'cell'``: the channel-adaptive CNN or ViT (``train_arch``) on single-cell crops (:func:`run_cell_architecture`). Optionally the ViT is first pre-trained without labels (``pretrain_method``: ``'mae'``, He et al. 2022, or ``'dino'``, Caron et al. 2021) for ``pretrain_epochs`` epochs; ``train_labels_per_class`` then keeps only that many labelled cells per class (few-shot). Every model is scored on the full stain panel and on each subset of ``eval_channel_subsets`` (the missing-stain evaluation), beside a majority-class control and, with ``train_set_shuffle_control``, a model trained on shuffled labels.
records.translation: ``'cell'``: rásaðlagaða CNN-ið eða ViT-ið (``train_arch``) á skurðum stakra frumna (:func:`run_cell_architecture`). Valfrjálst er ViT-ið fyrst forþjálfað án merkja (``pretrain_method``: ``'mae'``, He et al. 2022, eða ``'dino'``, Caron et al. 2021) í ``pretrain_epochs`` lotur; ``train_labels_per_class`` heldur svo aðeins þeim fjölda merktra frumna á hvern flokk (few-shot). Hvert líkan er metið á öllu litunarsafninu og á hverju hlutmengi ``eval_channel_subsets`` (matið með vantandi litunum), við hlið meirihlutaflokksviðmiðs og, með ``train_set_shuffle_control``, líkans sem er þjálfað á stokkuðum merkjum.

records.context: Cell extracted image regions come as one ``(cells, channels, height, width)`` array (``train_cell_crops``, ``.npy``) with a row-aligned table (``train_cell_table``) holding the label and the group (well) column; cells are split by group, so no well is in both training and test. The extracted image regions are raw: each image data channel is divided by the 99th percentile of up to 2,048 training extracted image regions, clipped at 1.5 and mapped by ``(x - 0.5) / 0.25``, the transform of the gene-class benchmark. Training augments by flips, 90-degree rotations and a per-image data channel gain within 10%.
records.label: spacr.architecture_training#4
records.source: Cell crops come as one ``(cells, channels, height, width)`` array (``train_cell_crops``, ``.npy``) with a row-aligned table (``train_cell_table``) holding the label and the group (well) column; cells are split by group, so no well is in both training and test. The crops are raw: each channel is divided by the 99th percentile of up to 2,048 training crops, clipped at 1.5 and mapped by ``(x - 0.5) / 0.25``, the transform of the gene-class benchmark. Training augments by flips, 90-degree rotations and a per-channel gain within 10%.
records.translation: Frumuskurðir koma sem eitt ``(cells, channels, height, width)``-fylki (``train_cell_crops``, ``.npy``) með röðuðu töflu (``train_cell_table``) sem geymir merkjadálkinn og hópdálkinn (brunn); frumum er skipt eftir hópi, svo enginn brunnur er bæði í þjálfun og prófun. Skurðirnir eru hráir: hver rás er deilt með 99. hundraðshlutamarki allt að 2,048 þjálfunarskurða, klippt við 1.5 og varpað með ``(x - 0.5) / 0.25``, umbreytingu genaflokkaviðmiðsins. Þjálfunin eykur gögnin með speglunum, 90 gráðu snúningum og mögnun á hverja rás innan 10%.

records.source: All three models take any number of channels (1 to more than 10) with the same weights. Every channel is processed on its own and tagged with a learned stain embedding, looked up by stain name rather than by slot index, so BBBC021 "DNA" and an OPS "DAPI" share one vector and an unseen panel still runs.
records.translation: Öll þrjú líkönin taka hvaða fjölda rása sem er (frá 1 upp í fleiri en 10) með sömu vigtum. Hver rás er unnin ein og sér og merkt með lærðri litunargreypingu sem flett er upp eftir nafni litunar en ekki eftir sætisvísi, svo "DNA" í BBBC021 og "DAPI" í OPS deila einum vigri og óséð litunarsafn keyrir samt.

records.context: :class:`SpacrChannelCNN` is an image data channel-adaptive ConvNeXt-style CNN: a HyperNet stem per image data channel, ConvNeXt blocks shared across image data channels and FiLM-conditioned on the stain, cross-image data channel attention at every spatial location (one feature map per image data channel is kept) and image data channel attention pooling at the end, which records the stain that drove the call.
records.label: spacr.channel_models#2
records.source: :class:`SpacrChannelCNN` is a channel-adaptive ConvNeXt-style CNN: a HyperNet stem per channel, ConvNeXt blocks shared across channels and FiLM-conditioned on the stain, cross-channel attention at every spatial location (one feature map per channel is kept) and channel attention pooling at the end, which records the stain that drove the call.
records.translation: :class:`SpacrChannelCNN` er rásaðlagað CNN í ConvNeXt-stíl: HyperNet-stofn á hverja rás, ConvNeXt-blokkir sem deilt er milli rása og FiLM-skilyrtar á litunina, athygli milli rása á hverjum rúmfræðilegum stað (einu eiginleikakorti á rás er haldið) og rásaathyglissöfnun í lokin, sem skráir litunina sem réð niðurstöðunni.

records.context: :class:`SpacrChannelViT` is an image data channel-aware ViT: per-image data channel patch tokens plus a stain embedding and a 2-D sin-cos position, an optional per-sample image data channel-availability mask for missing stains, and Hierarchical image data channel Sampling (image data channel dropout, Bao et al. 2024) in training. It is pre-trained with :class:`ChannelMAE` (He et al. 2022) or :class:`ChannelDINO` (Caron et al. 2021).
records.label: spacr.channel_models#3
records.source: :class:`SpacrChannelViT` is a channel-aware ViT: per-channel patch tokens plus a stain embedding and a 2-D sin-cos position, an optional per-sample channel-availability mask for missing stains, and Hierarchical Channel Sampling (channel dropout, Bao et al. 2024) in training. It is pre-trained with :class:`ChannelMAE` (He et al. 2022) or :class:`ChannelDINO` (Caron et al. 2021).
records.translation: :class:`SpacrChannelViT` er rásameðvitað ViT: bútatákn á hverja rás auk litunargreypingar og 2-D sin-cos-staðsetningar, valfrjáls gríma á hvert sýni um tiltækar rásir fyrir vantandi litanir, og Hierarchical Channel Sampling (rásabrottfall, Bao et al. 2024) í þjálfun. Það er forþjálfað með :class:`ChannelMAE` (He et al. 2022) eða :class:`ChannelDINO` (Caron et al. 2021).

records.context: :class:`SpacrWellTransformer` is a set model over the single-cell embeddings of a well. Mode ``'arrayed'``: an ISAB set encoder (Lee et al. 2019) and gated multi-head attention-MIL pooling (Ilse et al. 2018) give the well logits, the attention weights and per-cell instance logits (the penetrant fraction, :func:`penetrant_fraction`). Mode ``'pooled'``: per-cell logits conditioned on a context set of other cells of the same well; an empty context is a learned null token, so the no-context ablation is the same model with set size 0.
records.label: spacr.channel_models#4
records.source: :class:`SpacrWellTransformer` is a set model over the single-cell embeddings of a well. Mode ``'arrayed'``: an ISAB set encoder (Lee et al. 2019) and gated multi-head attention-MIL pooling (Ilse et al. 2018) give the well logits, the attention weights and per-cell instance logits (the penetrant fraction, :func:`penetrant_fraction`). Mode ``'pooled'``: per-cell logits conditioned on a context set of other cells of the same well; an empty context is a learned null token, so the no-context ablation is the same model with set size 0.
records.translation: :class:`SpacrWellTransformer` er mengjalíkan yfir greypingar stakra frumna í brunni. Hamur ``'arrayed'``: ISAB-mengjakóðari (Lee et al. 2019) og stýrð attention-MIL-söfnun með mörgum hausum (Ilse et al. 2018) gefa logit brunnsins, athyglisvigtirnar og tilviks-logit hverrar frumu (gegnumbrotshlutfallið, :func:`penetrant_fraction`). Hamur ``'pooled'``: logit hverrar frumu skilyrt á samhengismengi annarra frumna úr sama brunni; tómt samhengi er lært núlltákn, svo brottnám samhengis er sama líkanið með mengjastærð 0.

records.context: :func:`build_channel_model` is the registry: it builds any of the three by the name in :data:`CHANNEL_ARCHITECTURES`, which is also what the train setting ``train_arch`` and :func:`spacr.utils.choose_model` accept. :class:`ChannelClassifier` gives the two image models the ``model(x) -> logits`` interface of the rest of spaCR's train path.

records.translation: :func:`build_channel_model` er skráin: hún byggir hvert þeirra þriggja eftir nafninu í :data:`CHANNEL_ARCHITECTURES`, sem er líka það sem þjálfunarstillingin ``train_arch`` og :func:`spacr.utils.choose_model` taka við. :class:`ChannelClassifier` gefur myndlíkönunum tveimur viðmótið ``model(x) -> logits`` sem restin af þjálfunarleið spaCR notar.

records.context: Tokens: one shared one-image data channel patch embedding per image data channel, plus the stain embedding and a 2-D sin-cos position shared over image data channels, so ``C * (img / patch) ** 2`` tokens and a CLS token. Default img 224 and patch 32 (49 tokens per image data channel). The native-resolution arm is img 96 / patch 12 (OPS) or img 128 / patch 16 (BBBC021). With ``bag_of_channels`` every image data channel is a separate sequence and the per-image data channel CLS vectors are fused late, which is cheaper and the better self-supervised setting on CHAMMI-75.
records.label: spacr.channel_models.SpacrChannelViT#1
records.source: Tokens: one shared one-channel patch embedding per channel, plus the stain embedding and a 2-D sin-cos position shared over channels, so ``C * (img / patch) ** 2`` tokens and a CLS token. Default img 224 and patch 32 (49 tokens per channel). The native-resolution arm is img 96 / patch 12 (OPS) or img 128 / patch 16 (BBBC021). With ``bag_of_channels`` every channel is a separate sequence and the per-channel CLS vectors are fused late, which is cheaper and the better self-supervised setting on CHAMMI-75.
records.translation: Tákn: ein sameiginleg einrásar-bútagreyping á hverja rás, auk litunargreypingarinnar og 2-D sin-cos-staðsetningar sem rásirnar deila, þannig ``C * (img / patch) ** 2`` tákn og CLS-tákn. Sjálfgefið img 224 og patch 32 (49 tákn á rás). Armurinn með upprunalegri upplausn er img 96 / patch 12 (OPS) eða img 128 / patch 16 (BBBC021). Með ``bag_of_channels`` er hver rás sérstök runa og CLS-vigrar hverrar rásar eru sameinaðir seint, sem er ódýrara og betri sjálfstýrða stillingin á CHAMMI-75.

records.source: The nine CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5 classifiers, built as CellProfiler Analyst builds them.
records.translation: Flokkararnir níu í CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5, byggðir eins og CellProfiler Analyst byggir þá.

records.context: CellProfiler Analyst (CPA; github.com/CellProfiler/CellProfiler-Analyst, commit f5e1b5e2b2c35bb1aff4516ae5a49fe420df0350, version 3.0.5, BSD 3-Clause licence, Copyright 2003-2024 Broad Institute) offers nine machine-learning classification models in its machine-learning classification model window. Eight are scikit-learn estimators that CPA's ``GeneralClassifier`` constructs from a fixed string, with an optional :class:`~sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler` fitted on the training data; :data:`CPA_GENERAL` holds the strings and scaler flags verbatim from ``cpa/classifier.py``. The ninth, FastGentleBoosting, is CPA's own boosted stumps (Torralba et al. 2007, "Sharing visual features for multiclass and multiview object detection", ieee pami), ported here from ``cpa/fastgentleboosting.py`` with the same arithmetic in ``float32``, the same unstable ``argsort`` and the same tie rule, and scored as CPA scores cells (sum over rules of ``a`` if ``x > threshold`` else ``b``, argmax).
records.label: spacr.cpa_classifiers#1
records.source: CellProfiler Analyst (CPA; github.com/CellProfiler/CellProfiler-Analyst, commit f5e1b5e2b2c35bb1aff4516ae5a49fe420df0350, version 3.0.5, BSD 3-Clause licence, Copyright 2003-2024 Broad Institute) offers nine classifiers in its Classifier window. Eight are scikit-learn estimators that CPA's ``GeneralClassifier`` constructs from a fixed string, with an optional :class:`~sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler` fitted on the training data; :data:`CPA_GENERAL` holds the strings and scaler flags verbatim from ``cpa/classifier.py``. The ninth, FastGentleBoosting, is CPA's own boosted stumps (Torralba et al. 2007, "Sharing visual features for multiclass and multiview object detection", IEEE PAMI), ported here from ``cpa/fastgentleboosting.py`` with the same arithmetic in ``float32``, the same unstable ``argsort`` and the same tie rule, and scored as CPA scores cells (sum over rules of ``a`` if ``x > threshold`` else ``b``, argmax).
records.translation: CellProfiler Analyst (CPA; github.com/CellProfiler/CellProfiler-Analyst, commit f5e1b5e2b2c35bb1aff4516ae5a49fe420df0350, útgáfa 3.0.5, BSD 3-Clause-leyfi, Copyright 2003-2024 Broad Institute) býður níu flokkara í Classifier-glugga sínum. Átta eru scikit-learn-matarar sem ``GeneralClassifier`` CPA smíðar úr fastri streng, með valfrjálsum :class:`~sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler` aðlöguðum að þjálfunargögnunum; :data:`CPA_GENERAL` geymir strengina og scaler-flöggin orðrétt úr ``cpa/classifier.py``. Sá níundi, FastGentleBoosting, eru eigin efldir stubbar CPA (Torralba et al. 2007, "Sharing visual features for multiclass and multiview object detection", IEEE PAMI), fluttir hingað úr ``cpa/fastgentleboosting.py`` með sömu reikningum í ``float32``, sama óstöðuga ``argsort`` og sömu reglu um jöfn gildi, og metnir eins og CPA metur frumur (summa yfir reglur af ``a`` ef ``x > threshold`` annars ``b``, argmax).

A machine-learning classification model that takes a ``random_state`` gets the fold's seed, as the BBBC021 reanalysis (``cpa_models.py``) set it. FastGentleBoosting has no probabilities: its additive scores go through a softmax so that averaging over a treatment's microplate sample positions is defined.

records.context: The computer-vision arm of the BBBC021 benchmark, from settings, in four steps that :func:`run_embedding_profiles` runs in order:
records.label: spacr.embedding_profiles#1
records.source: The computer-vision arm of the BBBC021 benchmark, from settings, in four steps that :func:`run_embedding_profiles` runs in order:
records.translation: Tölvusjónararmur BBBC021-viðmiðsins, út frá stillingum, í fjórum skrefum sem :func:`run_embedding_profiles` keyrir í röð:

records.context: 1. :func:`write_crop_shard` cuts a fixed-size window around each chosen cell of a laboratory microplate from its merged microscope fields of view (:func:`spacr.crops.open_merged_field`), raw: never stretched per extracted image region (item 772), optionally divided by the laboratory microplate's saved flat microscope field of view (``crop_illumination='gain_offset'``), with a bit-flag mask (1 this cell, 2 any nucleus, 4 another cell, 8 outside the microscope field of view). At most ``crop_cap_per_well`` cells per microplate sample position are drawn by ``numpy.random.default_rng(crop_seed)``, microplate sample position by microplate sample position in sorted order. One HDF5 shard per laboratory microplate holds ``images`` and ``masks``, beside a ``.cells.parquet`` with one row per extracted image region; 2. :func:`embed_crop_shard` encodes the masked extracted image regions with a pretrained backbone (:mod:`spacr.embeddings`), each image data channel alone, under one fixed scale per laboratory microplate and image data channel (the 99th percentile of a 2,048-extracted image region sample, item 410); 3. :func:`aggregate_embedding_wells` writes ``wells_median.parquet``, ``wells_mean.parquet`` and the control cells' percentiles in the layout of the feature aggregate (:func:`spacr.screen_staging.aggregate_wells`), so :func:`spacr.sp_stats.moa_evaluation` scores them unchanged; 4. :func:`well_umap` writes a UMAP (McInnes et al. 2018) of the microplate sample positions.
records.label: spacr.embedding_profiles#2
records.source: 1. :func:`write_crop_shard` cuts a fixed-size window around each chosen cell of a plate from its merged fields (:func:`spacr.crops.open_merged_field`), raw: never stretched per crop (item 772), optionally divided by the plate's saved flat field (``crop_illumination='gain_offset'``), with a bit-flag mask (1 this cell, 2 any nucleus, 4 another cell, 8 outside the field). At most ``crop_cap_per_well`` cells per well are drawn by ``numpy.random.default_rng(crop_seed)``, well by well in sorted order. One HDF5 shard per plate holds ``images`` and ``masks``, beside a ``.cells.parquet`` with one row per crop; 2. :func:`embed_crop_shard` encodes the masked crops with a pretrained backbone (:mod:`spacr.embeddings`), each channel alone, under one fixed scale per plate and channel (the 99th percentile of a 2,048-crop sample, item 410); 3. :func:`aggregate_embedding_wells` writes ``wells_median.parquet``, ``wells_mean.parquet`` and the control cells' percentiles in the layout of the feature aggregate (:func:`spacr.screen_staging.aggregate_wells`), so :func:`spacr.sp_stats.moa_evaluation` scores them unchanged; 4. :func:`well_umap` writes a UMAP (McInnes et al. 2018) of the wells.
records.translation: 1. :func:`write_crop_shard` sker glugga af fastri stærð utan um hverja valda frumu plötu úr sameinuðum sviðum hennar (:func:`spacr.crops.open_merged_field`), hráan: aldrei teygðan fyrir hvern skurð (item 772), valfrjálst deilt með vistuðu flatsviði plötunnar (``crop_illumination='gain_offset'``), með bitaflöggagrímu (1 þessi fruma, 2 hvaða kjarni sem er, 4 önnur fruma, 8 utan sviðsins). Í mesta lagi ``crop_cap_per_well`` frumur á hvern brunn eru dregnar af ``numpy.random.default_rng(crop_seed)``, brunn fyrir brunn í raðaðri röð. Einn HDF5-bútur á hverja plötu geymir ``images`` og ``masks``, við hlið ``.cells.parquet`` með einni röð á hvern skurð; 2. :func:`embed_crop_shard` kóðar grímuðu skurðina með forþjálfuðum hrygg (:mod:`spacr.embeddings`), hverja rás eina og sér, undir einum föstum kvarða á hverja plötu og rás (99. hundraðshlutamark 2,048 skurða úrtaks, item 410); 3. :func:`aggregate_embedding_wells` skrifar ``wells_median.parquet``, ``wells_mean.parquet`` og hundraðshlutamörk viðmiðsfrumnanna í uppsetningu eiginleikasamantektarinnar (:func:`spacr.screen_staging.aggregate_wells`), svo :func:`spacr.sp_stats.moa_evaluation` metur þau óbreytt; 4. :func:`well_umap` skrifar UMAP (McInnes et al. 2018) af brunnunum.

records.context: For each cell the window of side ``size`` centred on its rounded centroid in the ``cell`` label image layer is read from ``merged/<plate>_<well>_<site>_1.npy`` (zero padded past the edge). Writes ``<out>/<plate>.h5`` (``images`` uint16 ``(n, size, size, channels)`` and ``masks`` uint8, gzip 4, chunks of 32), ``<plate>.cells.parquet`` (the cells in shard order with ``row``, centroid, bounding box, mask area, clipped pixels and ``truncated``) and ``<plate>.json``.
records.label: spacr.embedding_profiles.write_crop_shard#1
records.source: For each cell the window of side ``size`` centred on its rounded centroid in the ``cell`` label plane is read from ``merged/<plate>_<well>_<site>_1.npy`` (zero padded past the edge). With ``illumination`` the plate's flat field is applied as Measure applies it: ``rint((window - offset) * gain)``, clipped to uint16 and the clipped pixels counted. ``mask_flags`` adds the bit mask of :data:`MASK_BITS`. Writes ``<out>/<plate>.h5`` (``images`` uint16 ``(n, size, size, channels)`` and ``masks`` uint8, gzip 4, chunks of 32), ``<plate>.cells.parquet`` (the cells in shard order with ``row``, centroid, bounding box, mask area, clipped pixels and ``truncated``) and ``<plate>.json``.
records.translation: Fyrir hverja frumu er glugginn með hliðina ``size``, miðjaður á námundaðan massamiðju hennar í merkjaplaninu ``cell``, lesinn úr ``merged/<plate>_<well>_<site>_1.npy`` (núllfylltur út fyrir jaðarinn). Með ``illumination`` er flatsviði plötunnar beitt eins og Measure beitir því: ``rint((window - offset) * gain)``, klippt í uint16 og klipptir pixlar taldir. ``mask_flags`` bætir við bitagrímu :data:`MASK_BITS`. Skrifar ``<out>/<plate>.h5`` (``images`` uint16 ``(n, size, size, channels)`` og ``masks`` uint8, gzip 4, kubbar af 32), ``<plate>.cells.parquet`` (frumurnar í röð bútsins með ``row``, massamiðju, umlykjandi kassa, flatarmáli grímu, klipptum pixlum og ``truncated``) og ``<plate>.json``.

records.translation: Þetta er myndhelmingur item 889, fluttur úr ``gc_train.py`` BMC-endurgreiningarinnar svo að viðmiðs- eða tilraunaskipting sé spaCR-keyrsla. Ein skipting:

records.context: 1. the extracted image regions: :class:`MemmapCrops` (BBBC021, a ``(cells, H, W, C)`` uint16 ``.npy`` with an index table holding ``scale0..`` per cell) or :class:`OpsCrops` (OPS, cell-masked TIFF extracted image regions in tar shards with ``.index.csv`` byte offsets and a per-laboratory microplate scale file). Both divide by a fixed per-laboratory microplate, per-image data channel scale and clip, so extracted image regions stay raw on disk; 2. the labels and folds: :func:`bbbc_fold_setup` (MoA classes and the NSCB / NSC folds of :func:`spacr.well_set_training.moa_folds`) or :func:`ops_fold_setup` (multi-label gene classes from the :mod:`spacr.gene_classes` tables, gene folds, decoy heads, the shuffled control and the per-gene loss weight); 3. the sampler (``train_balanced_sampling``): :class:`BalancedSampler`, class-uniform for BBBC021 and, for OPS, :func:`class_gene_sampler` (half the batch from positive genes, class then gene then cell; half from negative genes); 4. the model (``train_arch``, :data:`IMAGE_ARCHITECTURES`): :func:`build_image_model` with the first convolution adapted to the image data channel count (:func:`adapt_first_conv`); 5. the transform: :func:`transform_spec` records the whole preprocessing, which is saved with the fold and checked again before scoring (:func:`check_transform`, item 772). :class:`DevicePrep` applies it on the device, with the train-time augmentation (dihedral, shift of up to 4 px, per-image data channel gain 0.9 to 1.1); 6. :func:`train_image_fold` trains with AdamW and a cosine schedule (AMP on a GPU, micro-batch halving on out-of-memory) and scores the held-out cells; :func:`score_bbbc_run` scores a BBBC021 run per microplate sample position and per treatment.
records.label: spacr.gene_class_images#2
records.source: 1. the crops: :class:`MemmapCrops` (BBBC021, a ``(cells, H, W, C)`` uint16 ``.npy`` with an index table holding ``scale0..`` per cell) or :class:`OpsCrops` (OPS, cell-masked TIFF crops in tar shards with ``.index.csv`` byte offsets and a per-plate scale file). Both divide by a fixed per-plate, per-channel scale and clip, so crops stay raw on disk; 2. the labels and folds: :func:`bbbc_fold_setup` (MoA classes and the NSCB / NSC folds of :func:`spacr.well_set_training.moa_folds`) or :func:`ops_fold_setup` (multi-label gene classes from the :mod:`spacr.gene_classes` tables, gene folds, decoy heads, the shuffled control and the per-gene loss weight); 3. the sampler (``train_balanced_sampling``): :class:`BalancedSampler`, class-uniform for BBBC021 and, for OPS, :func:`class_gene_sampler` (half the batch from positive genes, class then gene then cell; half from negative genes); 4. the model (``train_arch``, :data:`IMAGE_ARCHITECTURES`): :func:`build_image_model` with the first convolution adapted to the channel count (:func:`adapt_first_conv`); 5. the transform: :func:`transform_spec` records the whole preprocessing, which is saved with the fold and checked again before scoring (:func:`check_transform`, item 772). :class:`DevicePrep` applies it on the device, with the train-time augmentation (dihedral, shift of up to 4 px, per-channel gain 0.9 to 1.1); 6. :func:`train_image_fold` trains with AdamW and a cosine schedule (AMP on a GPU, micro-batch halving on out-of-memory) and scores the held-out cells; :func:`score_bbbc_run` scores a BBBC021 run per well and per treatment.
records.translation: 1. skurðirnir: :class:`MemmapCrops` (BBBC021, ``(cells, H, W, C)``-fylki af gerðinni uint16 í ``.npy`` með vísistöflu sem geymir ``scale0..`` á hverja frumu) eða :class:`OpsCrops` (OPS, frumugrímaðir TIFF-skurðir í tar-bútum með bætahliðrunum í ``.index.csv`` og kvarðaskrá á hverja plötu). Báðir deila með föstum kvarða á hverja plötu og rás og klippa, svo skurðirnir haldast hráir á diski; 2. merkin og skiptingarnar: :func:`bbbc_fold_setup` (MoA-flokkar og NSCB- / NSC-skiptingar :func:`spacr.well_set_training.moa_folds`) eða :func:`ops_fold_setup` (fjölmerkja genaflokkar úr töflum :mod:`spacr.gene_classes`, genaskiptingar, tálbeituhausar, stokkaða viðmiðið og tapsvigt á hvert gen); 3. úrtakarinn (``train_balanced_sampling``): :class:`BalancedSampler`, jafndreifður eftir flokkum fyrir BBBC021 og, fyrir OPS, :func:`class_gene_sampler` (helmingur lotunnar úr jákvæðum genum, flokkur svo gen svo fruma; helmingur úr neikvæðum genum); 4. líkanið (``train_arch``, :data:`IMAGE_ARCHITECTURES`): :func:`build_image_model` með fyrstu földunina aðlagaða að fjölda rása (:func:`adapt_first_conv`); 5. umbreytingin: :func:`transform_spec` skráir alla forvinnsluna, sem er vistuð með skiptingunni og prófuð aftur fyrir mat (:func:`check_transform`, item 772). :class:`DevicePrep` beitir henni á tækinu, með gagnaaukningu þjálfunar (tvíflötungsvarpanir, hliðrun um allt að 4 px, mögnun á hverja rás 0.9 til 1.1); 6. :func:`train_image_fold` þjálfar með AdamW og kósínusáætlun (AMP á GPU, helmingun smálotu þegar minni þrýtur) og metur frátöku frumurnar; :func:`score_bbbc_run` metur BBBC021-keyrslu á hvern brunn og hverja meðferð.

records.context: A gene class is a set of screened genes that share an annotation: a kinase group, family or subfamily (KinHub, Manning et al. 2002), a CORUM complex, a KEGG pathway, a GO-slim biological process, or a direction of one of Funk et al. 2022's per-gene feature scores. :func:`build_gene_classes` builds the class table from versioned source files (md5 recorded), merges or drops near-duplicate classes, and splits the genes into folds with multi-label iterative stratification (Sechidis et al. 2011, :func:`grouped_multilabel_folds`), so every class has members in every fold and no gene is in two folds.
records.label: spacr.gene_classes#1
records.source: A gene class is a set of screened genes that share an annotation: a kinase group, family or subfamily (KinHub, Manning et al. 2002), a CORUM complex, a KEGG pathway, a GO-slim biological process, or a direction of one of Funk et al. 2022's per-gene feature scores. :func:`build_gene_classes` builds the class table from versioned source files (md5 recorded), merges or drops near-duplicate classes, and splits the genes into folds with multi-label iterative stratification (Sechidis et al. 2011, :func:`grouped_multilabel_folds`), so every class has members in every fold and no gene is in two folds.
records.translation: Genaflokkur er safn skimaðra gena sem deila skýringu: kínasahópur, -ætt eða -undirætt (KinHub, Manning et al. 2002), CORUM-flóki, KEGG-ferill, líffræðilegt ferli í GO-slim eða stefna í einu af eiginleikastigum Funk et al. 2022 fyrir hvert gen. :func:`build_gene_classes` byggir flokkatöfluna úr útgáfumerktum upprunaskrám (md5 skráð), sameinar eða fellir brott nær tvítekna flokka og skiptir genunum í skiptingar með ítrekaðri fjölmerkjalagskiptingu (Sechidis et al. 2011, :func:`grouped_multilabel_folds`), svo hver flokkur hefur meðlimi í hverri skiptingu og ekkert gen er í tveimur skiptingum.

records.context: :func:`train_gene_class_baseline` fits one logistic regression per class on a gene-level feature table, fold by fold, with optional decoy heads (random gene sets of the classes' sizes, the null of the discovery calls) and a shuffled-class control. :func:`evaluate_gene_class_run` scores the out-of-fold predictions: per-class AUROC and average precision with bootstrap intervals, specificity against phenotype-positive and overlapping-class non-members, and the two discovery lists (known members with a new image phenotype; predicted new functions) at BH q < 0.05 against the decoy heads.
records.label: spacr.gene_classes#2
records.source: :func:`train_gene_class_baseline` fits one logistic regression per class on a gene-level feature table, fold by fold, with optional decoy heads (random gene sets of the classes' sizes, the null of the discovery calls) and a shuffled-class control. :func:`evaluate_gene_class_run` scores the out-of-fold predictions: per-class AUROC and average precision with bootstrap intervals, specificity against phenotype-positive and overlapping-class non-members, and the two discovery lists (known members with a new image phenotype; predicted new functions) at BH q < 0.05 against the decoy heads.
records.translation: :func:`train_gene_class_baseline` aðlagar eina lógistíska aðhvarfsgreiningu á hvern flokk á eiginleikatöflu á genastigi, skiptingu fyrir skiptingu, með valfrjálsum tálbeituhausum (slembnum genasöfnum af stærðum flokkanna, núlltilgátu uppgötvunarkallanna) og viðmiði með stokkuðum flokkum. :func:`evaluate_gene_class_run` metur spárnar utan skiptingar: AUROC og meðalnákvæmni á hvern flokk með bootstrap-bilum, sértækni gagnvart svipgerðarjákvæðum ómeðlimum og ómeðlimum úr skarandi flokkum, og listana tvo yfir uppgötvanir (þekktir meðlimir með nýja myndsvipgerð; spáð ný virkni) við BH q < 0.05 gagnvart tálbeituhausunum.

records.context: Per class (and decoy head) the positives are the held-out trainable members and the negatives every scored non-member; AUROC and AP with bootstrap intervals, AUROC against control pseudo-genes, against phenotype-positive non-members and against members of overlapping classes, for members unique to the class, and for members with and without a screening experiment phenotype. A class is specific when its AUROC interval is above 0.5 and both specificity AUROCs are above 0.5. Discovery: each head is z-scored over genes; with 100 or more size-matched decoy heads a gene's p value is its rank on the decoy heads (the gene-wise null), else against the pooled decoy z; BH within each type: (a) members without a screening experiment phenotype that score as members (a new image phenotype), (b) non-members of a specific class whose best class it is (a predicted new function).
records.label: spacr.gene_classes.evaluate_gene_class_run#1
records.source: Per class (and decoy head) the positives are the held-out trainable members and the negatives every scored non-member; AUROC and AP with bootstrap intervals, AUROC against control pseudo-genes, against phenotype-positive non-members and against members of overlapping classes, for members unique to the class, and for members with and without a screen phenotype. A class is specific when its AUROC interval is above 0.5 and both specificity AUROCs are above 0.5. Discovery: each head is z-scored over genes; with 100 or more size-matched decoy heads a gene's p value is its rank on the decoy heads (the gene-wise null), else against the pooled decoy z; BH within each type: (a) members without a screen phenotype that score as members (a new image phenotype), (b) non-members of a specific class whose best class it is (a predicted new function).
records.translation: Fyrir hvern flokk (og tálbeituhaus) eru jákvæðu dæmin fráteknu þjálfanlegu meðlimirnir og neikvæðu dæmin allir metnir ómeðlimir; AUROC og AP með bootstrap-bilum, AUROC gagnvart viðmiðsgervigenum, gagnvart svipgerðarjákvæðum ómeðlimum og gagnvart meðlimum skarandi flokka, fyrir meðlimi sem tilheyra aðeins flokknum, og fyrir meðlimi með og án svipgerðar í skimuninni. Flokkur er sértækur þegar AUROC-bil hans er yfir 0.5 og bæði sértækni-AUROC eru yfir 0.5. Uppgötvun: hver haus er z-staðlaður yfir genin; með 100 eða fleiri stærðarpöruðum tálbeituhausum er p-gildi gens sæti þess meðal tálbeituhausanna (núlltilgáta hvers gens), annars gagnvart sameinuðu tálbeitu-z; BH innan hverrar gerðar: (a) meðlimir án svipgerðar í skimuninni sem fá stig eins og meðlimir (ný myndsvipgerð), (b) ómeðlimir sértæks flokks sem er besti flokkur þeirra (spáð ný virkni).

records.translation: Ljósfræðileg sameinuð skimun gefur eitt snið á hvert gen. Hvort þessi snið segi eitthvað um virkni gena sem birtu víxlverkunarkortin vissu ekki þegar er metið hér með tveimur samskiptareglum, hvorri með sín viðmið:

records.context: the **time split**: the model is trained on the gene-gene edges known in 2022 (STRING v11.5, BioGRID 4.4.214, CORUM 3.0) and scored on the edges added since (``gene_graph_new_edges``), among every gene pair that was not a 2022 edge;
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#2
records.source: the **time split**: the model is trained on the gene-gene edges known in 2022 (STRING v11.5, BioGRID 4.4.214, CORUM 3.0) and scored on the edges added since (``gene_graph_new_edges``), among every gene pair that was not a 2022 edge;
records.translation: **tímaskiptingin**: líkanið er þjálfað á leggjum milli gena sem voru þekktir 2022 (STRING v11.5, BioGRID 4.4.214, CORUM 3.0) og metið á leggjunum sem hafa bæst við síðan (``gene_graph_new_edges``), meðal allra genapara sem voru ekki leggur 2022;

records.context: **held-out genes**: for fold ``k`` every edge and every category membership of the fold's genes is hidden; the model scores those genes against every gene and every category.
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#3
records.source: **held-out genes**: for fold ``k`` every edge and every category membership of the fold's genes is hidden; the model scores those genes against every gene and every category.
records.translation: **frátekin gen**: fyrir skiptingu ``k`` eru allir leggir og öll flokkaaðild gena skiptingarinnar falin; líkanið metur þessi gen gagnvart öllum genum og öllum flokkum.

records.context: The steps, each callable on its own and all four in order by :func:`run_gene_graph` (what ``spacr-run gene_graph`` calls):
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#4
records.source: The steps, each callable on its own and all four in order by :func:`run_gene_graph` (what ``spacr-run gene_graph`` calls):
records.translation: Skrefin, hvert hægt að kalla eitt og sér og öll fjögur í röð með :func:`run_gene_graph` (það sem ``spacr-run gene_graph`` kallar):

records.context: :func:`build_gene_graph` assembles the nodes (screening experiment genes and non-targeting pseudo-genes), the feature blocks with their missing indicators, the typed edges, the categories and the folds;
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#5
records.source: :func:`build_gene_graph` assembles the nodes (screen genes and non-targeting pseudo-genes), the feature blocks with their missing indicators, the typed edges, the categories and the folds;
records.translation: :func:`build_gene_graph` setur saman hnútana (skimunargen og óbeind gervigen), eiginleikablokkirnar með vöntunarvísum sínum, tegundaða leggina, flokkana og skiptingarnar;

records.context: :func:`train_gene_graph` runs the models: a graph transformer (``gps``), GraphSAGE (``sage``), GCN (``gcn``), Hadamard logistic regression (``lr``) and a Laplacian-eigenmap embedding (``spectral``), plus the training-free baselines ``cosine``, ``adamicadar`` and ``prior``, each over feature arms and under the controls ``shufX`` (features permuted among genes), ``shufY`` (labels relabelled by a gene permutation) and ``rewire`` (degree-preserving swaps);
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#6
records.source: :func:`train_gene_graph` runs the models: a graph transformer (``gps``), GraphSAGE (``sage``), GCN (``gcn``), Hadamard logistic regression (``lr``) and a Laplacian-eigenmap embedding (``spectral``), plus the training-free baselines ``cosine``, ``adamicadar`` and ``prior``, each over feature arms and under the controls ``shufX`` (features permuted among genes), ``shufY`` (labels relabelled by a gene permutation) and ``rewire`` (degree-preserving swaps);
records.translation: :func:`train_gene_graph` keyrir líkönin: net-transformer (``gps``), GraphSAGE (``sage``), GCN (``gcn``), Hadamard-lógistíska aðhvarfsgreiningu (``lr``) og greypingu með Laplace-eiginkortlagningu (``spectral``), auk þjálfunarlausu grunnlínanna ``cosine``, ``adamicadar`` og ``prior``, hvert yfir eiginleikaarma og undir viðmiðunum ``shufX`` (eiginleikum umraðað meðal gena), ``shufY`` (merki endurmerkt með umröðun gena) og ``rewire`` (víxl sem varðveita gráðu);

records.context: :func:`evaluate_gene_graph` writes the time-split and held-out metrics, the per-fold summaries, the ablation table and the paired fold deltas;
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#7
records.source: :func:`evaluate_gene_graph` writes the time-split and held-out metrics, the per-fold summaries, the ablation table and the paired fold deltas;
records.translation: :func:`evaluate_gene_graph` skrifar mælikvarða tímaskiptingarinnar og fráteknu genanna, samantektir á hverja skiptingu, brottnámstöfluna og pöruðu mismunina milli skiptinga;

records.context: :func:`predict_gene_functions` calibrates the out-of-fold scores, controls the false discovery rate with the non-targeting pseudo-genes as decoys and writes the explained prediction lists.
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#8
records.source: :func:`predict_gene_functions` calibrates the out-of-fold scores, controls the false discovery rate with the non-targeting pseudo-genes as decoys and writes the explained prediction lists.
records.translation: :func:`predict_gene_functions` kvarðar stigin utan skiptingar, stýrir hlutfalli falskra uppgötvana með óbeindu gervigenunum sem tálbeitum og skrifar útskýrðu spálistana.

records.context: The models are plain PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy and scikit-learn. They run on the device named by ``gene_graph_device``; a CUDA device that is not available falls back to the CPU. On CUDA, the card rule of the shared workstation applies: a processing session waits until the card total plus its cap stays below ``gene_graph_gpu_limit_gb`` for ``gene_graph_admission_hold_s`` seconds, yields (saving a resume file) when the card goes over the limit, and stops when ``gene_graph_gpu_budget_h`` GPU hours are used. On the CPU the computation is deterministic, so a rerun from the saved settings file writes the same tables.
records.label: spacr.gene_graph#9
records.source: The models are plain PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy and scikit-learn. They run on the device named by ``gene_graph_device``; a CUDA device that is not available falls back to the CPU. On CUDA, the card rule of the shared workstation applies: a run waits until the card total plus its cap stays below ``gene_graph_gpu_limit_gb`` for ``gene_graph_admission_hold_s`` seconds, yields (saving a resume file) when the card goes over the limit, and stops when ``gene_graph_gpu_budget_h`` GPU hours are used. On the CPU the computation is deterministic, so a rerun from the saved settings file writes the same tables.
records.translation: Líkönin eru einfalt PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy og scikit-learn. Þau keyra á tækinu sem ``gene_graph_device`` nefnir; CUDA-tæki sem er ekki tiltækt fellur aftur á CPU. Á CUDA gildir kortaregla sameiginlegu vinnustöðvarinnar: keyrsla bíður þar til heildarnotkun kortsins auk þaks hennar helst undir ``gene_graph_gpu_limit_gb`` í ``gene_graph_admission_hold_s`` sekúndur, lætur kortið eftir (og vistar framhaldsskrá) þegar kortið fer yfir mörkin, og stöðvast þegar ``gene_graph_gpu_budget_h`` GPU-klukkustundir hafa verið notaðar. Á CPU er útreikningurinn ákvarðaður, svo endurkeyrsla úr vistuðu stillingaskránni skrifar sömu töflur.

records.context: Per epoch (graph models), ``node_mask`` of the supervisable genes are node-masked (held-out tasks) and ``edge_mask`` of the other training edges are hidden and supervised; negatives are ``neg_per_pos`` per positive, half uniform and half degree-proportional, never a known pair. ``lr`` supervises every training edge (a minibatch of positives) and every training gene. Early stopping on the inner validation keeps the best state. The final scoring graph holds every training edge with the validation genes restored; test genes stay isolated. Every epoch draws from ``default_rng([seed, s, epoch])`` and the resume file carries the torch random state, so a resumed run scores like an uninterrupted one.
records.label: spacr.gene_graph.run_config#1
records.source: Per epoch (graph models), ``node_mask`` of the supervisable genes are node-masked (held-out tasks) and ``edge_mask`` of the other training edges are hidden and supervised; negatives are ``neg_per_pos`` per positive, half uniform and half degree-proportional, never a known pair. ``lr`` supervises every training edge (a minibatch of positives) and every training gene. Early stopping on the inner validation keeps the best state. The final scoring graph holds every training edge with the validation genes restored; test genes stay isolated. Every epoch draws from ``default_rng([seed, s, epoch])`` and the resume file carries the torch random state, so a resumed run scores like an uninterrupted one.
records.translation: Í hverri lotu (netlíkön) eru ``node_mask`` af stýranlegu genunum hnútgrímuð (verkefni með frátekin gen) og ``edge_mask`` af hinum þjálfunarleggjunum falin og stýrð; neikvæð dæmi eru ``neg_per_pos`` á hvert jákvætt, helmingur jafndreifður og helmingur í hlutfalli við gráðu, aldrei þekkt par. ``lr`` stýrir öllum þjálfunarleggjum (smálota af jákvæðum) og öllum þjálfunargenum. Snemmbúin stöðvun á innri fullgildingunni heldur bestu stöðunni. Lokamatsnetið geymir alla þjálfunarleggi með fullgildingargenin endurheimt; prófunargen haldast einangruð. Hver lota dregur úr ``default_rng([seed, s, epoch])`` og framhaldsskráin ber slembistöðu torch, svo keyrsla sem haldið er áfram metur eins og órofin keyrsla.

records.source: What a screen adds to gene-function prediction can only be stated against what prior protein knowledge alone predicts. This module builds that knowledge on the gene graph's node order (:mod:`spacr.gene_graph`): one row per screen gene and one per non-targeting pseudo-gene.
records.translation: Hvað skimun bætir við spá um virkni gena er aðeins hægt að segja gagnvart því sem fyrri próteinþekking ein og sér spáir. Þessi eining byggir þá þekkingu í hnútaröð genanetsins (:mod:`spacr.gene_graph`): ein röð á hvert skimunargen og ein á hvert óbeint gervigen.

records.context: No hosted model or API is used. Models run from local Hugging Face weights (``gene_knowledge_models_dir``); they are downloaded only when ``gene_knowledge_allow_download`` is on. records.label: spacr.gene_knowledge#10
records.source: No hosted model or API is used. Models run from local Hugging Face weights (``gene_knowledge_models_dir``); they are downloaded only when ``gene_knowledge_allow_download`` is on. records.translation: Ekkert hýst líkan eða API er notað. Líkön keyra út frá staðbundnum Hugging Face-vigtum (``gene_knowledge_models_dir``); þeim er aðeins hlaðið niður þegar kveikt er á ``gene_knowledge_allow_download``. Hvert skref getur í staðinn endurnýtt vistað úttak fyrri keyrslu (``*_embeddings``, ``*_outputs``, ``foldseek_alignments``), sem er hvernig keyrsla er endurtekin án GPU.

records.source: A plate-scale phenotype run holds the card for days, so it must not start while another job is using it, and it must give the card back cleanly. The reference launcher of the Funk et al. 2022 run did this in a shell script; :class:`GpuAdmission` is that behaviour as a policy that can be tested without a GPU:
records.translation: Svipgerðarkeyrsla á plötuskala heldur skjákortinu dögum saman, svo hún má ekki hefjast á meðan annað verk notar það, og hún verður að skila kortinu snyrtilega. Viðmiðunarræsirinn fyrir keyrslu Funk et al. 2022 gerði þetta í skeljaskriftu; :class:`GpuAdmission` er sú hegðun sem regla sem hægt er að prófa án GPU:

records.label: spacr.gpu_admission#3
records.source: then wait for ``idle_checks`` samples in a row in which the card shows 0 % utilisation and no running compute process uses more than ``min_process_mib``. Skjá- og vafraferli teljast aldrei (``ignore_patterns``: ``--type=gpu-process`` vafra hélt um 600 MiB og stíflaði viðmiðunarræsinn klukkustundum saman), og ekki heldur stöðvuð ferli;

records.source: Reads the merged arrays of ``translocation_merged_folder`` (or ``<src>/merged``). With ``cell_from_nucleus_expand_px`` above 0 a five-plane array ``[c0, c1, c2, nucleus, parasite]`` gets its cell plane from the nuclei first (:func:`nucleus_territories`) and becomes the six-plane layout; a six-plane array already has its cell plane (Make Masks grows the territories itself with the same setting) and is read as it is. Cells are marked ``cell_source`` nucleus_territory when the territories were grown here or the merged folder's plane layout says Make Masks grew them; the territories are not cell outlines. Then :func:`translocation_cells` per field and :func:`translocation_summary`, written to ``<src>/translocation/`` (cells_translocation.csv, the summary tables, reference_curve.csv when ``translocation_reference`` names a reference curve table, and the translocation_ratio_vs_vacuoles figure of :func:`translocation_figure`).
records.translation: Les sameinuðu fylki ``translocation_merged_folder`` (eða ``<src>/merged``). Með ``cell_from_nucleus_expand_px`` yfir 0 fær fimm-plana fylki ``[c0, c1, c2, nucleus, parasite]`` fyrst frumuplan sitt út frá kjörnunum (:func:`nucleus_territories`) og verður sex-plana uppsetningin; sex-plana fylki hefur þegar frumuplan sitt (Make Masks stækkar svæðin sjálft með sömu stillingu) og er lesið eins og það er. Frumur eru merktar ``cell_source`` nucleus_territory þegar svæðin voru stækkuð hér eða uppsetning planana í sameinuðu möppunni segir að Make Masks hafi stækkað þau; svæðin eru ekki útlínur frumna. Síðan :func:`translocation_cells` á hvert svið og :func:`translocation_summary`, skrifað í ``<src>/translocation/`` (cells_translocation.csv, samantektartöflurnar, reference_curve.csv þegar ``translocation_reference`` nefnir töflu viðmiðunarferils, og myndina translocation_ratio_vs_vacuoles úr :func:`translocation_figure`).

records.source: For every field in ``<mask_src>/nucleus_mask_stack`` the nuclei under ``min_nucleus_size`` pixels are removed and the rest grow by up to ``expand_px`` pixels (:func:`nucleus_territories`). The territories are written to ``<mask_src>/cell_mask_stack`` and the kept nuclei to ``<mask_src>/nucleus_territory_seed_stack``, both as ``.npy`` in the nucleus mask's dtype, so the merged arrays carry a cell plane, the nucleus plane holds the nuclei the territories grew from, and Measure reads them like any other cell mask.
records.translation: Fyrir hvert svið í ``<mask_src>/nucleus_mask_stack`` eru kjarnar undir ``min_nucleus_size`` pixlum fjarlægðir og hinir stækkaðir um allt að ``expand_px`` pixla (:func:`nucleus_territories`). records.context: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a microplate sample position can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; ``ph_flatfield`` builds the laboratory microplate's maps once, before the microplate sample positions, and ``ph_masks`` writes each cell's microscope field of view-edge flags and flat-microscope field of view gains from the saved masks. A processing session of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its microplate sample positions from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each microplate sample position's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the microplate sample positions run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``merge``) writes each microscope field of view to ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (after ``aggregate``) writes the standard ``measurements/measurements.db`` tables (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` cuts raw extracted image regions of owned cells into a sharded store (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``ph_masks``) finds the copies of each cell across overlapping microscope fields of view (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, last, writes the yield funnel and the counts against a published table to ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). With ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` set, each microplate sample position's second phenotype acquisition is registered before its microscope fields of view are read (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). The alpha ``decode_qc`` phase (items 876 and 877) fits the false-call model and the genotype confidence over the microplate sample positions decoded, writing ``results/ops_decode_qc``; it also executes after ``decode`` when ``ops_decode_qc`` or ``ops_genotype_confidence`` is on. The alpha ``compare_calls`` phase (item 878) matches spaCR's calls to other workflows' per-cell tables (``ops_compare_tables``) and writes ``results/ops_compare``; it also executes after ``decode`` when those tables are set. The alpha profile path, ``"profile"`` and ``"evaluate"``, runs alone: it turns the stored cell tables of ``ops_profile_cells`` into gene profiles and scores them against reference gene pairs (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`); ``"modules"`` builds the module atlas of those profiles (:func:`spacr.ops_modules.run_module_phase`) and ``"mitocarta"`` scores clusterings against MitoCarta and an external module table (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.run_mitocarta_benchmark`); like the profile path, both hold the BLAS and OpenMP pools to one thread while ``ops_deterministic_blas`` is on (the result's ``atlas_blas_threads``). ``"stress"``, after ``report``, times the finished store and writes ``results/ops_stress/stress_test.csv`` (:func:`spacr.ops_run_infra.stress_rows`); ``ops_stress_report`` runs it too.

records.source: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a well can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; ``ph_flatfield`` builds the plate's maps once, before the wells, and ``ph_masks`` writes each cell's field-edge flags and flat-field gains from the saved masks. A run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its wells from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each well's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the wells run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (per well, after ``merge``) writes each field to ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (after ``aggregate``) writes the standard ``measurements/measurements.db`` tables (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` cuts raw crops of owned cells into a sharded store (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (per well, after ``ph_masks``) finds the copies of each cell across overlapping fields (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, last, writes the yield funnel and the counts against a published table to ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). With ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` set, each well's second phenotype acquisition is registered before its fields are read (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). The alpha ``decode_qc`` phase (items 876 and 877) fits the false-call model and the genotype confidence over the wells decoded, writing ``results/ops_decode_qc``; it also runs after ``decode`` when ``ops_decode_qc`` or ``ops_genotype_confidence`` is on. The alpha ``compare_calls`` phase (item 878) matches spaCR's calls to other pipelines' per-cell tables (``ops_compare_tables``) and writes ``results/ops_compare``; it also runs after ``decode`` when those tables are set. The alpha profile path, ``"profile"`` and ``"evaluate"``, runs alone: it turns the stored cell tables of ``ops_profile_cells`` into gene profiles and scores them against reference gene pairs (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`); ``"modules"`` builds the module atlas of those profiles (:func:`spacr.ops_modules.run_module_phase`) and ``"mitocarta"`` scores clusterings against MitoCarta and an external module table (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.run_mitocarta_benchmark`); like the profile path, both hold the BLAS and OpenMP pools to one thread while ``ops_deterministic_blas`` is on (the result's ``atlas_blas_threads``). ``"stress"``, after ``report``, times the finished store and writes ``results/ops_stress/stress_test.csv`` (:func:`spacr.ops_run_infra.stress_rows`); ``ops_stress_report`` runs it too.
records.translation: eitthvað af ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` og ``"decode"``, keyrt í þeirri röð. Fasi sem er sleppt les það sem hann þarf úr gagnagrunninum, svo hægt er að skeyta brunn saman einu sinni og afkóða hann aftur. Alfaleið svipgerðar bætir við ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` og ``"aggregate"``, sem keyra aðeins þegar þau eru nefnd hér og á eftir þessum fjórum; ``ph_flatfield`` byggir kort plötunnar einu sinni, á undan brunnunum, og ``ph_masks`` skrifar sviðsjaðarflögg og flatsviðsmagnanir hverrar frumu út frá vistuðu grímunum. Keyrsla með aðeins þessum þarf ``dst_root`` og ``plate`` en ekkert ``genotype_source``, tekur brunna sína úr ``ops_phenotype`` og bætir við ``ops_report.json`` hvers brunns í stað þess að skipta henni út. ``aggregate`` sameinar keyrðu brunnana og skrifar ``ops_guides_<plate>`` og ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (á hvern brunn, á eftir ``merge``) skrifar hvert svið í ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (á eftir ``aggregate``) skrifar staðaltöflurnar í ``measurements/measurements.db`` (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` sker hráa skurði eigna frumna í bútaða geymslu (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (á hvern brunn, á eftir ``ph_masks``) finnur afrit hverrar frumu yfir skarandi svið (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, síðast, skrifar afkastatrektina og fjöldann borinn saman við birta töflu í ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). Þegar ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` er stillt er önnur svipgerðarmyndataka hvers brunns skráð áður en svið hans eru lesin (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). Alfafasinn ``decode_qc`` (items 876 og 877) aðlagar líkanið fyrir röng köll og arfgerðarvissuna yfir afkóðuðu brunnana og skrifar ``results/ops_decode_qc``; hann keyrir líka á eftir ``decode`` þegar kveikt er á ``ops_decode_qc`` eða ``ops_genotype_confidence``. Alfafasinn ``compare_calls`` (item 878) parar köll spaCR við töflur annarra vinnsluleiða fyrir hverja frumu (``ops_compare_tables``) og skrifar ``results/ops_compare``; hann keyrir líka á eftir ``decode`` þegar þær töflur eru stilltar. Alfaleið sniða, ``"profile"`` og ``"evaluate"``, keyrir ein og sér: hún breytir vistuðum frumutöflum ``ops_profile_cells`` í gensnið og metur þau gagnvart viðmiðunargenapörum (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`); ``"modules"`` byggir einingakortabók þessara sniða (:func:`spacr.ops_modules.run_module_phase`) og ``"mitocarta"`` metur klasanir gagnvart MitoCarta og ytri einingatöflu (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.run_mitocarta_benchmark`); eins og sniðaleiðin halda bæði BLAS- og OpenMP-söfnunum við einn þráð á meðan kveikt er á ``ops_deterministic_blas`` (``atlas_blas_threads`` niðurstöðunnar). ``"stress"``, á eftir ``report``, tímamælir fullbúnu geymsluna og skrifar ``results/ops_stress/stress_test.csv`` (:func:`spacr.ops_run_infra.stress_rows`); ``ops_stress_report`` keyrir hann líka.

The atlas is built in three steps.
records.label: spacr.ops_modules#1
records.source: A module is a cluster of the reference clustering that is anchored by known biology (a CORUM complex, a KEGG pathway or a GO-slim term enriched in it), together with the genes the screen places next to that core although no resource links them to it. The atlas is built in three steps.
records.translation: Eining er klasi í viðmiðunarklasuninni sem er festur í þekktri líffræði (CORUM-flóka, KEGG-ferli eða GO-slim-hugtaki sem er auðgað í honum), ásamt genunum sem skimunin setur við hlið þess kjarna þótt engin heimild tengi þau við hann. Kortabókin er byggð í þremur skrefum.

records.context: 1. **Partitions.** The gene profiles (targeting genes with more than ten cells, plus the control guides grouped at random into pseudo-genes of four, :func:`spacr.ops_clusters.consensus_rows`) are clustered once with PHATE + Leiden (seed 42) at the resolutions of :data:`MODULE_RESOLUTIONS` (about 70, 250 and 500 clusters), and again ``ops_modules_runs`` times on resampled rows and guides (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.consensus_run`). By default the profiles are standardised and reduced to the components holding 99 % of the variance first. With ``ops_modules_precomputed_embedding`` the profile columns are used as they are, which is what a weighted profile (contrastive weighting) needs: standardising it again would undo the weighting. 2. **Anchoring.** In every reference cluster, a one-sided Fisher test for every group of 3 to 500 clustered genes, Benjamini-Hochberg within the cluster; the best group with q < 0.05 and three or more cluster genes is the anchor and its cluster genes are the known core. 3. **Data-selection boundaries.** A gene not linked to the core (no STRING v12 link of 0.4 or more, no BioGRID physical interaction, no shared enriched group) is a stable new member when its co-membership with the core over the consensus runs is above 0.5 and above the 99th percentile of both the control pseudo-genes and 500 fitness-matched random genes, its mean cosine to the core is above that of 1,000 fitness-matched genes (p < 0.01), at least three of its four guides point at the core, and its guides carry no specificity flag.
records.label: spacr.ops_modules#2
records.source: 1. **Partitions.** The gene profiles (targeting genes with more than ten cells, plus the control guides grouped at random into pseudo-genes of four, :func:`spacr.ops_clusters.consensus_rows`) are clustered once with PHATE + Leiden (seed 42) at the resolutions of :data:`MODULE_RESOLUTIONS` (about 70, 250 and 500 clusters), and again ``ops_modules_runs`` times on resampled rows and guides (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.consensus_run`). By default the profiles are standardised and reduced to the components holding 99 % of the variance first. With ``ops_modules_precomputed_embedding`` the profile columns are used as they are, which is what a weighted profile (contrastive weighting) needs: standardising it again would undo the weighting. 2. **Anchoring.** In every reference cluster, a one-sided Fisher test for every group of 3 to 500 clustered genes, Benjamini-Hochberg within the cluster; the best group with q < 0.05 and three or more cluster genes is the anchor and its cluster genes are the known core. 3. **Gates.** A gene not linked to the core (no STRING v12 link of 0.4 or more, no BioGRID physical interaction, no shared enriched group) is a stable new member when its co-membership with the core over the consensus runs is above 0.5 and above the 99th percentile of both the control pseudo-genes and 500 fitness-matched random genes, its mean cosine to the core is above that of 1,000 fitness-matched genes (p < 0.01), at least three of its four guides point at the core, and its guides carry no specificity flag.
records.translation: 1. **Skiptingar.** Gensniðin (markgen með fleiri en tíu frumur, auk viðmiðsleiðaranna sem flokkaðir eru af handahófi í gervigen af fjórum, :func:`spacr.ops_clusters.consensus_rows`) eru klösuð einu sinni með PHATE + Leiden (fræ 42) við upplausnir :data:`MODULE_RESOLUTIONS` (um 70, 250 og 500 klasar), og aftur ``ops_modules_runs`` sinnum á endurúrteknum röðum og leiðurum (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.consensus_run`). Sjálfgefið eru sniðin fyrst stöðluð og smættuð í þættina sem geyma 99 % af dreifninni. Með ``ops_modules_precomputed_embedding`` eru sniðdálkarnir notaðir eins og þeir eru, sem er það sem vegið snið (andstæðuvigtun) þarf: að staðla það aftur myndi afmá vigtunina. 2. **Festing.** Í hverjum viðmiðunarklasa er gert einhliða Fisher-próf fyrir hvern hóp með 3 til 500 klösuðum genum, Benjamini-Hochberg innan klasans; besti hópurinn með q < 0.05 og þrjú eða fleiri gen klasans er festan og gen hans í klasanum eru þekkti kjarninn. 3. **Skilyrði.** Gen sem er ekki tengt kjarnanum (engin STRING v12-tenging upp á 0.4 eða meira, engin efnisleg BioGRID-víxlverkun, enginn sameiginlegur auðgaður hópur) er stöðugur nýr meðlimur þegar sameiginleg aðild þess með kjarnanum yfir samhljóða keyrslurnar er yfir 0.5 og yfir 99. hundraðshlutamarki bæði viðmiðsgervigenanna og 500 slembigena pöruðum eftir fitness, meðalkósínus þess við kjarnann er yfir því sem 1,000 gen pöruð eftir fitness hafa (p < 0.01), að minnsta kosti þrír af fjórum leiðurum þess benda á kjarnann, og leiðarar þess bera ekkert sértæknisflagg.

records.context: The BBBC021 benchmark (Ljosa et al. 2013) as the reanalysis's scorer of record runs it (``run_and_score.py`` and ``supervised_moa.py``):
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.moa_evaluation#1
records.source: The BBBC021 benchmark (Ljosa et al. 2013) as the reanalysis's scorer of record runs it (``run_and_score.py`` and ``supervised_moa.py``):
records.translation: BBBC021-viðmiðið (Ljosa et al. 2013) eins og opinberi matari endurgreiningarinnar keyrir það (``run_and_score.py`` og ``supervised_moa.py``):

records.context: 1. every microplate sample position gets its laboratory microplate, microplate sample position, compound and concentration (from ``metadata`` when the profiles lack them) and every numeric column outside the structured-data names, counts and ``moa_eval_exclude`` is a feature; 2. each laboratory microplate is normalised to its control microplate sample positions (``moa_eval_normalise``) and a feature without a finite positive scale on some laboratory microplate is dropped; ``moa_eval_feature_qc='standard'`` then drops a feature non-finite in more than 5% of microplate sample positions or above 500 after normalisation (pycytominer's drop_na_columns and drop_outliers, item 807); 3. the labelled microplate sample positions (``moa_eval_labels``, controls left out) are scored by each method of ``moa_eval_methods``, leaving one compound out (:mod:`spacr.moa_benchmark`): ``1nn_cosine`` on treatment profiles (replicate microplate sample positions combined by ``moa_eval_replicates``), and the supervised ``logistic``, ``xgboost``, ``lda``, ``shrinkage_lda``, ``knn`` and the nine CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5 machine-learning classification models ``cpa_<name>`` (:mod:`spacr.cpa_classifiers`) on the microplate sample positions, as ``float32``; 4. per seed the supervised fits use that seed, and the shuffled-label control permutes the compound-to-MoA mapping with generator seed ``seed + 1`` and refits with seeds ``seed + 1 + i`` (the reference's convention at seed 0); the 1-NN control uses generator seed ``seed``. The majority-class control counts the treatments the first method scored.
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.moa_evaluation#2
records.source: 1. every well gets its plate, well, compound and concentration (from ``metadata`` when the profiles lack them) and every numeric column outside the keys, counts and ``moa_eval_exclude`` is a feature; 2. each plate is normalised to its control wells (``moa_eval_normalise``) and a feature without a finite positive scale on some plate is dropped; ``moa_eval_feature_qc='standard'`` then drops a feature non-finite in more than 5% of wells or above 500 after normalisation (pycytominer's drop_na_columns and drop_outliers, item 807); 3. the labelled wells (``moa_eval_labels``, controls left out) are scored by each method of ``moa_eval_methods``, leaving one compound out (:mod:`spacr.moa_benchmark`): ``1nn_cosine`` on treatment profiles (replicate wells combined by ``moa_eval_replicates``), and the supervised ``logistic``, ``xgboost``, ``lda``, ``shrinkage_lda``, ``knn`` and the nine CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5 classifiers ``cpa_<name>`` (:mod:`spacr.cpa_classifiers`) on the wells, as ``float32``; 4. per seed the supervised fits use that seed, and the shuffled-label control permutes the compound-to-MoA mapping with generator seed ``seed + 1`` and refits with seeds ``seed + 1 + i`` (the reference's convention at seed 0); the 1-NN control uses generator seed ``seed``. The majority-class control counts the treatments the first method scored.
records.translation: 1. hver brunnur fær plötu sína, brunn, efnasamband og styrk (úr ``metadata`` þegar sniðin vantar þau) og hver tölulegur dálkur utan lyklanna, fjöldatalnanna og ``moa_eval_exclude`` er eiginleiki; 2. hver plata er stöðluð miðað við viðmiðsbrunna sína (``moa_eval_normalise``) og eiginleika án endanlegs jákvæðs kvarða á einhverri plötu er sleppt; ``moa_eval_feature_qc='standard'`` sleppir síðan eiginleika sem er óendanlegur í meira en 5% brunna eða yfir 500 eftir stöðlun (drop_na_columns og drop_outliers úr pycytominer, item 807); 3. merktu brunnarnir (``moa_eval_labels``, viðmiðum sleppt) eru metnir með hverri aðferð í ``moa_eval_methods``, með einu efnasambandi haldið utan (:mod:`spacr.moa_benchmark`): ``1nn_cosine`` á meðferðarsniðum (endurteknir brunnar sameinaðir með ``moa_eval_replicates``), og stýrðu aðferðirnar ``logistic``, ``xgboost``, ``lda``, ``shrinkage_lda``, ``knn`` og flokkararnir níu ``cpa_<name>`` úr CellProfiler Analyst 3.0.5 (:mod:`spacr.cpa_classifiers`) á brunnunum, sem ``float32``; 4. fyrir hvert fræ nota stýrðu aðlaganirnar það fræ, og viðmiðið með stokkuðum merkjum umraðar vörpun efnasambands á MoA með rafalsfræinu ``seed + 1`` og endurmetur með fræjunum ``seed + 1 + i`` (venja viðmiðunarinnar við fræ 0); 1-NN-viðmiðið notar rafalsfræið ``seed``. Meirihlutaflokksviðmiðið telur meðferðirnar sem fyrsta aðferðin mat.

This module trains the :class:`spacr.channel_models.SpacrWellTransformer` on those sets, the way the BMC reanalysis ``train_well.py`` did, and scores it on BBBC021-style mechanism-of-action (MoA) folds:
records.label: spacr.well_set_training#1
records.source: A well is a set of single-cell embeddings (such as the per-channel ResNet-18 embeddings :mod:`spacr.embedding_profiles` writes, ``<plate>.npy`` beside the crop index ``<plate>.cells.parquet``). This module trains the :class:`spacr.channel_models.SpacrWellTransformer` on those sets, the way the BMC reanalysis ``train_well.py`` did, and scores it on BBBC021-style mechanism-of-action (MoA) folds:
records.translation: Brunnur er safn greypinga stakra frumna (eins og ResNet-18-greypingarnar á hverja rás sem :mod:`spacr.embedding_profiles` skrifar, ``<plate>.npy`` við hlið skurðavísisins ``<plate>.cells.parquet``). Þessi eining þjálfar :class:`spacr.channel_models.SpacrWellTransformer` á þessum söfnum, eins og ``train_well.py`` BMC-endurgreiningarinnar gerði, og metur hann á skiptingum eftir verkunarmáta (MoA) í BBBC021-stíl:

records.context: 1. :func:`load_cell_embeddings` reads the embeddings and normalises them without labels (``train_set_normalisation``): ``'plate_control_pca'`` centres and scales every dimension per laboratory microplate by that laboratory microplate's control (DMSO) cells, then whitens with a PCA fitted on control cells of all laboratory microplates (typical-variation-normalisation-like, Ando et al. 2017); the control is the negative control on every laboratory microplate, so using it on test laboratory microplates is not label leakage. ``'plate_control'`` stops after the laboratory microplate step and ``'none'`` keeps the embeddings as they are. 2. :func:`group_wells` groups the cells into microplate sample positions, and :func:`moa_folds` gives the folds of ``train_protocol``: ``'NSCB'`` (not same compound or batch: one fold per batch, plus the taxol 1 and 3 uM fold) or ``'NSC'`` (not same compound: four folds, every compound of a MoA in another fold). 3. :func:`train_arrayed` trains one arm per fold, and :func:`predict_arrayed` predicts the test microplate sample positions. Arms (:data:`WELL_SET_ARMS`): ``settf`` (ISAB set encoder and gated attention-MIL), ``abmil`` (attention-MIL only), ``n1`` (set size 1 in training and test, the well being the mean of its cells' softmax: the no-context ablation), ``mixbag`` (bags drawn from cells of random training microplate sample positions of the same class, which keeps the label but breaks within-well co-occurrence), ``mean_lr`` (mean profile and logistic regression) and ``mean_knn`` (mean profile and cosine 1-NN on treatment profiles, the classic BBBC021 baseline). 4. :func:`score_treatments` scores the microplate sample positions as the reference ``eval_bbbc.py`` does: well softmax with untrained classes zeroed, treatment mean, argmax; accuracy with a bootstrap confidence interval over treatments, macro AUROC and macro AP.
records.label: spacr.well_set_training#2
records.source: 1. :func:`load_cell_embeddings` reads the embeddings and normalises them without labels (``train_set_normalisation``): ``'plate_control_pca'`` centres and scales every dimension per plate by that plate's control (DMSO) cells, then whitens with a PCA fitted on control cells of all plates (typical-variation-normalisation-like, Ando et al. 2017); the control is the negative control on every plate, so using it on test plates is not label leakage. ``'plate_control'`` stops after the plate step and ``'none'`` keeps the embeddings as they are. 2. :func:`group_wells` groups the cells into wells, and :func:`moa_folds` gives the folds of ``train_protocol``: ``'NSCB'`` (not same compound or batch: one fold per batch, plus the taxol 1 and 3 uM fold) or ``'NSC'`` (not same compound: four folds, every compound of a MoA in another fold). 3. :func:`train_arrayed` trains one arm per fold, and :func:`predict_arrayed` predicts the test wells. Arms (:data:`WELL_SET_ARMS`): ``settf`` (ISAB set encoder and gated attention-MIL), ``abmil`` (attention-MIL only), ``n1`` (set size 1 in training and test, the well being the mean of its cells' softmax: the no-context ablation), ``mixbag`` (bags drawn from cells of random training wells of the same class, which keeps the label but breaks within-well co-occurrence), ``mean_lr`` (mean profile and logistic regression) and ``mean_knn`` (mean profile and cosine 1-NN on treatment profiles, the classic BBBC021 baseline). 4. :func:`score_treatments` scores the wells as the reference ``eval_bbbc.py`` does: well softmax with untrained classes zeroed, treatment mean, argmax; accuracy with a bootstrap confidence interval over treatments, macro AUROC and macro AP.
records.translation: 1. :func:`load_cell_embeddings` les greypingarnar og staðlar þær án merkja (``train_set_normalisation``): ``'plate_control_pca'`` miðjar og kvarðar hverja vídd á hverja plötu með viðmiðsfrumum (DMSO) þeirrar plötu og hvítar síðan með PCA sem aðlöguð er á viðmiðsfrumum allra platna (líkt stöðlun dæmigerðrar breytileika, Ando et al. 2017); viðmiðið er neikvæða viðmiðið á hverri plötu, svo notkun þess á prófunarplötum er ekki merkjaleki. ``'plate_control'`` stöðvast eftir plötuskrefið og ``'none'`` heldur greypingunum eins og þær eru. 2. :func:`group_wells` flokkar frumurnar í brunna, og :func:`moa_folds` gefur skiptingar ``train_protocol``: ``'NSCB'`` (ekki sama efnasamband né lota: ein skipting á hverja lotu, auk skiptingarinnar með taxol við 1 og 3 uM) eða ``'NSC'`` (ekki sama efnasamband: fjórar skiptingar, hvert efnasamband MoA í annarri skiptingu). 3. :func:`train_arrayed` þjálfar einn arm á hverja skiptingu, og :func:`predict_arrayed` spáir fyrir prófunarbrunnana. Armar (:data:`WELL_SET_ARMS`): ``settf`` (ISAB-mengjakóðari og stýrð attention-MIL), ``abmil`` (attention-MIL eingöngu), ``n1`` (mengjastærð 1 í þjálfun og prófun, þar sem brunnurinn er meðaltal softmax frumna sinna: brottnám samhengis), ``mixbag`` (mengi dregin úr frumum slembinna þjálfunarbrunna úr sama flokki, sem heldur merkinu en rýfur samtilvist innan brunns), ``mean_lr`` (meðalsnið og lógistísk aðhvarfsgreining) og ``mean_knn`` (meðalsnið og kósínus-1-NN á meðferðarsniðum, sígilda BBBC021-grunnlínan). 4. :func:`score_treatments` metur brunnana eins og ``eval_bbbc.py`` viðmiðunarinnar gerir: softmax brunns með óþjálfaða flokka núllstillta, meðaltal meðferðar, argmax; nákvæmni með bootstrap-öryggisbili yfir meðferðir, macro-AUROC og macro-AP.

records.translation: ``'NSCB'``: ein skipting á hverja lotu (``week``, raðað eftir númeri sínu), sem prófar brunna vikunnar án taxol og þjálfar á öllum öðrum vikum; síðan taxol-skipting, sem prófar taxol við 1 og 3 uM og þjálfar á brunnum án taxol úr hinum vikunum. ``'NSC'``: fjórar skiptingar; innan hvers MoA er efnasamböndunum deilt í skiptingar 0, 1, 2, 3 í umröðun sem dregin er með fræi 0.

records.context: Every step draws ``bag_batch`` classes uniformly, a training well of each and a bag of ``bag_cells`` cells of it (``n1``: one cell; ``mixbag``: cells from ``mixbag_pool``). The loss is the label-smoothed well cross-entropy plus ``instance_weight`` times the per-cell cross-entropy, with AdamW, gradient clipping at 1 and :func:`cosine_schedule`.
